## 🗑️ Feature Removal Reminder - September 30, 2026 - EOL

**Appsmith AI reached end of life on September 30, 2026.**

You can no longer add new Appsmith AI datasource connections or queries. Existing queries have stopped working, whether or not you have upgraded.

Migrate remaining Appsmith AI queries to a direct provider datasource, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google AI.

## ⚠️ Important Upgrade Notes

- Git-connected applications update to server schema 13 when they are next opened. This can create a one-time system commit. Applications exported from this release cannot be imported into an older server that supports only schema 12. ([#42322](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42322))
- When you change a datasource connection setting, you must enter the credentials again for the active authentication, TLS, and SSH settings. Unchanged connections can continue to use saved credentials. ([#42339](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42339))
- Elasticsearch body bindings now use typed JSON substitution. Review queries that insert serialized JSON, build part of a JSON string, or construct dynamic paths. Invalid bindings now return a query error. ([#42342](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42342))

## 🔐 Security

- Updated bundled dependencies to address reported vulnerabilities. ([#42314](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42314), [#42324](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42324), [#42331](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42331))
- Datasource credential reuse is now tied to the saved connection configuration, and datasource test, structure, and trigger requests use stricter permission checks. ([#42339](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42339))
- Requests from the evaluation environment now keep the credential-omission guard even if the global request constructor changes. ([#42355](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42355))
- Login rate limits now use the same normalized account identity as authentication. ([#42337](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42337))
- Datasource updates now preserve the identity of the datasource selected by the request. ([#42356](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42356))
- Elasticsearch queries now validate substituted JSON and dynamic path values before execution. ([#42342](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42342))

## 🛠️ Reliability

- Prepared MySQL stored procedure calls can now run with a trailing query and keep bound values as data. ([#42329](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42329))
- Failed OAuth2 and SSO logins now return users to the instance login page. ([#42330](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42330))
- Zones in cards, tabs, sheets, and list items now use the full available width instead of collapsing into a narrow column. ([#42364](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42364))
- MCP datasource creation now lets the server select the correct environment. ([#42341](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42341))

## ✨ New Features & Enhancements

- Applications can now have an optional description that appears on application cards. ([#42312](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42312))
- List widgets now have a **Disable selection** option for apps that do not need row selection or item-click behavior. ([#42261](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42261))
- MCP can now create and update structured JS objects, use more MongoDB filter types, patch more widget settings, wire JS function calls, and detect common layout issues. ([#42311](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42311))

## 🎨 UI & Widget Improvements

- Table columns now have an optional **Header wrapping** setting for long column titles. ([#42354](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42354))
- Table headers now support configurable font weight, italic text, and underlining. ([#42323](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42323))
- The Applications page now stays below the missing base URL banner, so workspace controls remain visible. ([#42319](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42319))

## 🔧 Git, Deployment & Configuration

- MCP logs now record the actual result of each tool call and keep the correct request ID on related backend calls. ([#42350](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42350))
